columns.name: id
columns.description: Primary key: unique identifier for each stock record

columns.name: sku
columns.description: Stock Keeping Unit identifier; part of composite unique key with location (PI1)

columns.name: location
columns.description: Storage location identifier; part of composite unique key with sku (PI1)

columns.name: quantity
columns.description: Current stock quantity; enforced non-negative by CHECK constraint (PI3)

columns.name: inventory_code
columns.description: Inventory tracking code for audit and traceability

columns.name: created_at
columns.description: Immutable timestamp of record creation (NFR-F1-1: R1 data integrity)

columns.name: created_by
columns.description: Immutable identifier of actor who created the record (NFR-F1-1: R1 audit trail)

columns.name: updated_by
columns.description: Identifier of actor who last updated the record

schema_changes.detail: Create stock_records table with composite unique constraint on (sku, location). Columns: id (UUID PK), sku (NOT NULL), location (NOT NULL), quantity (NOT NULL, CHECK >= 0), inventory_code (NOT NULL), created_at/created_by (immutable audit), updated_at/updated_by (mutable audit). Unique index on (sku, location) ensures no duplicate pairs; check constraint enforces non-negative quantity at write time (R2: NFR-F1-2).
schema_changes.migration_note: Additive-only initial table creation. Downgrade drops the table. Foundation for stock visibility across all SKU-location pairs.
